notes: Read by redesign/blender/. Colours are linear-sRGB floats for Blender node inputs (hex is the display value). Units: metres, millimetres where named, pixels at the figure's output width.

render.device_fallback: EEVEE_NEXT for drafts; final figures in Cycles

bench.comment: close-ups of hand work; warm, plain, no horizon

stage_gradient_for_web.comment: the page draws this gradient behind transparent hero PNGs; matches tokens.css --stage-top/--stage-bottom

lights.comment: three-point area lights relative to the camera azimuth; az = degrees left of camera (+) / right (-), el = elevation above the subject
lights.scale_rule: power scales with (subject_extent_m / 2.0)^2 so a 0.3 m detail and a 2.2 m aircraft read the same
lights.shadow_softness: area lights only; no sun lamp; no HDRI in figures (HDRI allowed for hero only, strength <= 0.6, neutral studio HDRI)

default_view.comment: front-left-above isometric-ish; left = port side of aircraft facing the viewer

fit.comment: frame the focus parts plus one context part; never the whole aircraft for a step

materials.comment: principled BSDF. Roughness 0 = mirror, 1 = matte. Colour by material class; never by subsystem (subsystem colour is for the web viewer and diagrams).

xps_foam.note: pink/blue XPS is rendered neutral cream so it reads as 'foam' in print

print_pla.note: all printed parts one light grey, layer lines off

carbon_tube.note: no weave texture; plain dark with coat

propeller.note: props shown static; no motion blur

wire_signal.note: signal/servo leads yellow; other colours only when the harness spec names them

emphasis.comment: every step figure has exactly three classes of part: act (what you touch now), built (what is already there), ghost (context that would hide the action).

act_secondary.note: fasteners and small hardware of the same action; lighter so the main part dominates

ghost.note: ghost parts still get a thin outline so the silhouette reads

hidden.note: everything not in act/built/ghost is not rendered

removed_part.note: a part being taken off is shown ghosted at its lifted position with a removal arrow (2-D pass)

outline.comment: Freestyle on silhouettes, borders, creases and external contour; thickness scales with output width

callouts.comment: 2-D annotation pass over the render (SVG or PIL). Positions in output pixels at the figure width; the render is scaled to width_px first.

leader.style: straight; one bend at most; never crosses another leader; never crosses the act part

label.use: only when the number alone is ambiguous; the numbered action list in the step card is the primary label

dimension.format: value then unit with a thin space: 310 mm

arrow.use: direction of motion (insert, slide, rotate); curved arrow for rotation

callouts.numbering: left to right, then top to bottom, matching the step's action list

dark_theme_variant.note: only for figures rendered with film_transparent and placed on the dark stage; print and manual use the light variant

three_view.layout: top above side, front to the right of side (third-angle); or three in a row for the web
three_view.dimensions: span, length, height, rotor diameter, CG position only

exploded.axis: per interface normal from interfaces.json; default +z for fasteners, along tube axis for slid parts
exploded.comment: distance = factor x part extent along the axis; parts with a joint_stack get a thin dashed assembly line (outline colour, 0.6 px) between mating faces
